text: Every bank holds millions of customer records. Names, phone numbers, Aadhaar, PAN, and card numbers.
Support agents, analysts, and auditors all need that data. And every query is a chance for it to leak.
Dream Guard puts one intelligent shield between your people and your databases.
It discovers sensitive data automatically, and masks it, by role.
Agents unmask a field only for a declared purpose, and a live ticket.
Everyone signs in through enterprise single sign on. And every access is sealed in a tamper evident audit chain.
Then, in one click, it exports signed compliance packs, for D P D P, R B I, and P C I.
Dream Guard. Protect the data. Keep the business moving.
